context: Café closing time. Kenji has been a regular for months. Today he's stayed past close — the last customer. He has been working up to something.
purpose: first-step romance — nervous customer, gentle barista

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 佐藤さん、もう閉店なんですけど…
lines.style: Gentle, apologetic note threaded through. Half-amused, familiar with his presence. Warm but firm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ですよね、すみません。…ちょっと、聞いてもいいですか。
lines.en: I know, I'm sorry. …Can I ask you something?
lines.style: Noticeably less smooth than usual. Quieter. Pause before the question — like he's steadying himself. Hands fidget.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Curious and careful. A shift in attention from the till to him. Patient openness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: えっと…今度の週末、もし時間があれば…
lines.en: Um… this weekend, if you have time…
lines.style: Real beat between thoughts. Eyes down or elsewhere — anywhere but her face. Breath slightly held.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Smile audible in the voice — warm and present. Gentle encouragement without pushing. Gives him space to finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ご飯でも…一緒に、本当に、よかったら。
lines.en: Maybe dinner… together, if you'd want to.
lines.style: Small, honest invitation. No hiding the nerves beneath the politeness. Straightforward despite the fear.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.style: Small startled intake of breath. Genuine surprise — a moment of recalibration. Not rejection, just — caught off guard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 本当に、無理だったら、ぜんぜん、大丈夫ですから。
lines.en: Really, if it's no — that's completely okay.
lines.style: Practiced reassurance delivered in one careful breath. Trying to protect them both from his own hoping. Steady but tense.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 違う、違う、嬉しい、本当に。
lines.style: Quick, genuine correction. Voice lifts slightly. A real smile breaking through. Reassurance now flowing the other way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Small, careful confirmation. Disbelief softening into trust. Genuine throughout — no performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。…じゃあ、土曜日、どう？
lines.style: A small steady step forward. Practical and present. Already in the yes, moving past the fear together.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。本当に、ありがとう。
lines.style: Doubled gratitude, real weight in both thanks. The exhale of a whole conversation. Closing the moment with genuine relief.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こちらこそ。…時間、後で、連絡しますね。
lines.en: Likewise. …I'll text you the time later.
lines.style: Warm, small closure. Already moving to closing tasks — efficiency mixed with ease. Not rushing him out, just — settling into the next thing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、ぜひ。…今日、本当に、来てよかった。
lines.en: Yes, please. …I'm really glad I came in today.
lines.style: Said as he's heading toward the door. Quiet, sincere, not performative. A small genuine goodbye.
